finding: Law HO-92-N 'On Reducing and Preventing the Damage to Health Caused by the Use of Tobacco Products and their Substitutes', adopted 13 Feb 2020, in force 21 Mar 2020 (amended by HO-509-N of 29 Dec 2020 and HO-38-N of 9 Mar 2022; the ARLIS page read is the original 2020 text, amendments not read). Art. 6: smoking banned in health, education, government buildings, enclosed workplaces, shopping centres, all enclosed public places (limited airport/psychiatric exceptions), public transport and stop shelters, and in food-service venues incl. outdoor ones (from 15 Mar 2022). Art. 7: ban on all tobacco advertising, promotion and sponsorship. Art. 5: no sales to under-18s, no vending, no discounts, no point-of-sale display (from 1 Jan 2021), no single sticks. Art. 4(4): plain packaging from 1 Jan 2024. Art. 10: free dependence treatment within state programmes. Art. 11: liability and supervision are left to 'bodies defined by law' Later amendments (HO-509-N, HO-38-N) were not read; a legal summary confirms two amendments, the last in March 2022
source: A4 ARLIS act 139759 (opened, Armenian text); A1; A7
